title: Pressure in a liquid
goal: See how the pressure in a liquid grows with depth.
note: Pressure in a liquid increases with depth. Here water has a density of 1000 kg/m3 and g is taken as 9.81 m/s2.

graphs.title: The pressure rises in a straight line with the depth.
graphs.label: Pressure

sentences: Turn the depth knob from 0 m to 20 m and watch the pressure grow.
steps: Turn the depth knob to take the probe deeper into the water.
Watch the arrows on the probe grow as the water presses harder.
Compare the pressure at 5 m and at 10 m.
hints: Pressure depends on how deep you are.
Compare the pressure at two different depths.
Try a depth of 5 m and then 10 m.
